question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c873f51d938b7a3ca48daf42d2a2914875ee4ac9a5e587fcf0b1f947db6a7225.png]
solution: The logic followed here is: 1) Letter element series → Letter element shift to the right side back and forth. Alternately letter element is replaced by letter element subsequently. No specific pattern is followed here for the alphabet element series, as it can be seen clearly that the letter element is replaced by new letter element randomly but no previous letter element used is repeated.
